gaps.message: These are budgeted allocations as adopted in May 2024, not what was actually spent. Later adjustment budgets may have changed them.
This budget uses the 2021 ward boundaries (116 wards). Ward numbers and areas changed in November 2026.
Some allocations are for several wards in a subcouncil (including unallocated amounts) and can't be attributed to one ward.
